comments.body: This issue will be fixed once https://github.com/Azure/sonic-platform-common/pull/157 is merged and the submodule is updated.

linkedPullRequests.title: Make sonic_sfp Python2 and Python3 compatible
linkedPullRequests.author: msosyak
linkedPullRequests.body:
Make `_read_eeprom_specific_bytes` Python3 and Python2 compatible

Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/6341

comments.author: lgtm-com
comments.body:
This pull request **introduces 1 alert** and **fixes 8** when merging 79d058d066f430a62c8d65c11daff9c5d64cffcc into ea59c0fb11a8f047f0db90b3bc2392616e558130 - [view on LGTM.com](https://lgtm.com/projects/g/Azure/sonic-platform-common/rev/pr-7f87417d151933c43704dc1d92d26e6a1a1b2a25)

**new alerts:**

* 1 for Syntax error

**fixed alerts:**

* 5 for Variable defined multiple times
* 3 for Unused local variable

comments.author: msosyak
comments.body:
> I noticed there is also a call to `self.eep_dict.iteritems()` on line 746. Can you also please change this to `self.eep_dict.items()` to make it compatible with both Python 2 and 3?

Done
